_about: Pinned texts of the fast prefill MoE's FC1 / FC2 kernels (VLLM_MOET_B12X_MOE_PREFILL_FAST_FC_TEXT). A text is the bytes of one kernel's .text section: another assembler's schedule of the same instructions, made from the compiler's text of that kernel. splice_fc_texts.py writes it over the TX = 1 twin of the kernel in the built extension - only where the compiler's own text of the kernel has the digest compiler_sha256, the text the pinned one was made from. `bit` is the kernel's bit in the loader's mask (set_fc_text_mask). A kernel without an entry in `texts` keeps the compiler's text in both twins and the key does not act on it.

texts.name: fc1.fp1_PH
texts.built: cubit, the record text's recipe with CUBIT_SCHED2_PACE=tensor and CUBIT_TENSOR_YIELD=holds
texts.status: measured on one card model (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition): for a test image only
